canonical_title: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers
description: Anthropic is using AI to automate the creation of newer, more powerful AI models. A report by AI safety group METR, based on an 11‑week investigation, says the company's models are improving roughly twice as quickly as they were a year ago, with no sign of slowing.

canonical_title: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" exposes passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files
description: The Claude Code AI coding assistant's "Don't Ask Again" option caused passwords to be written to 1,122 publicly accessible GitHub repositories, exposing the credentials.

canonical_title: Every Windows 11 app should kill Electron, and Discord just showed why
description: A recent Windows 11 build of Discord removed its initial loading screen and reportedly uses about 70% less RAM even when two accounts are signed in, which the article cites as evidence that Electron‑based apps are inefficient on Windows 11.

canonical_title: Show HN: Coldframe, a honeypot that poses as a supermarket fridge controller
description: A developer released Coldframe, a Python‑only honeypot that emulates the Danfoss AK‑SM 800A and Dixell XWEB supermarket refrigeration controller interfaces. The single‑file tool is designed to appear as a real device on Shodan, following recent attacks on industrial fridge installations.
A post titled "Goodbye Claude, Hello Pi" appeared on Hacker News, suggesting a discussion about moving from the Claude AI model to a new model called Pi.
